subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should embedded turns adopt this PR’s retry and terminal contract: configured retries may run inside the released-lock window, unconfigured SDK retries move to one bounded outer connection/timeout retry, and pure takeover ends as `run_failed` with resend guidance?
rationale: The pinned SDKs currently provide two local retries, while this PR deliberately changes retry ownership, total request behavior, and the user-visible terminal outcome; no maintainer discussion establishes the intended OpenClaw contract.

options.title: Approve current contract
options.body: Accept the layered retry behavior and resendable takeover outcome, then resolve the conflict and validate the exact final head.

options.title: Narrow retry ownership
options.body: Keep the transcript fencing and takeover visibility fixes while revising configured in-window retries or the outer retry layer.

options.title: Require durable recovery
options.body: Reject resend guidance as the terminal policy and pursue queued or automatic recovery separately.

recommendation.title: Approve current contract
recommendation.body: Accept the layered retry behavior and resendable takeover outcome, then resolve the conflict and validate the exact final head.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the newest overlapping lifecycle invariant and has the strongest current-main ownership signal across the session-lock and outer-runner decision surface.
